expo.name: 369Chats
expo.//: This app is 369Chats. Do NOT 'correct' the package to com.alphalize.369chats — an Android package segment is a Java identifier and may not start with a digit, so the package is chats369 while the slug is 369chats. Changing either one requires a matching Android client in google-services.json and a fresh dev-client build (the deep link is exp+<slug>).

expo.//eas: There is deliberately no projectId or owner here — the previous ones belonged to another account and another slug, and EAS rejected them. Run `npx eas init` while logged into an account you control to mint a fresh project, then `eas credentials` to re-upload the FCM V1 service-account key, which is stored per EAS project (see FIREBASE_PUSH_SETUP.md).
